## New Deferred Items from B19-L2

Items explicitly shelved in the B19-L2 architecture plan §11-§12 (No Scope Creep Protocol V12.23):

| ID | Description | Priority | Source |
|----|-------------|----------|--------|
| DW-B19L2-DEFER-01 | `ExitBufferTicks` value-object (JS-015): prevent raw `int` crossing the Trim/Flatten API boundary. Typed wrapper guards against out-of-range buffer values. Eliminates JS-015 (unvalidated primitive crossing API boundary). | P2 | B19-L2 arch plan §11-§12 |
| DW-B19L2-DEFER-02 | Spread validation guard in GetAsk/GetBid: reject stale or crossed quotes before placing limit order. Guard pattern: `if (ask - bid > maxSpreadTicks * tickSize) fall back to market`. Protects against wide-spread execution risk. | P2 | B19-L2 arch plan §11-§12 |
| DW-B19L2-DEFER-03 | `OnMarketData` event hook in TradeCopierPanel to subscribe to instrument market data events and cache the latest ask/bid tick. Eliminates stale-quote risk at button-press time (current implementation reads MarketData at click time only). | P2 | B19-L2 arch plan §11-§12 |
| DW-B19L2-DEFER-04 | Telemetry: log anchor price (ask or bid value, buffer ticks, computed limitPx) at each CreateOrder call in Trim/Flatten limit overloads, via StatusUpdate or dedicated telemetry hook. Improves observability of limit placement logic. | P3 | B19-L2 arch plan §11-§12 |
